lesson: Both trades failed due to over-reliance on local liquidity sweeps and micro-structure reversals while ignoring the dominant bearish trend. The system is currently misinterpreting noise as a trend reversal, leading to premature entries against the prevailing overhead supply.
adjustment: Require a confirmed Market Structure Shift (MSS) on the 4H timeframe before considering any long setups, regardless of 15m liquidity sweeps.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC liquidity sweeps less in a strong bearish trend; prioritize HTF Wyckoff distribution patterns.
